event.value: The deep settlements pass the news downward like a cave-in call: someone is moving through the realms above, shouting, armed, far from the sun. The Holdfast listens the way it listens for trapped voices.

The reports say the shouting is not panic but purpose. It does not fully believe them. It rumbles its path through the stone a little louder these days, per the Law of Fair Warning, so the lost one can find the way up when he wants it.

notes: BENCH boss — no meeting yet, and uniquely among the bench it reads the protagonist as a RESCUE CASE, not a threat (its profile position is 'sympathetic'; 'poor thing — no one that angry has ever been lost that long'). Hence the only positive trust on the boss roster: trust 5 and affection 10 are a rescue guardian's professional compassion for a lost soul; fear 15 is the dread of arriving too late at a collapse, transposed onto him. namedState 'rescue-case-inbound' captures that its whole plan for the invasion is to carry the invader out. Its canChangeCondition: hardens only as evidence piles up that the panic is purpose — and even then it grieves rather than hates, and would carry him to the surface the moment he dropped the sword. Deltas sum to current dimensions.
